title: Three-level hierarchy exercises SourceElaborator recursion end-to-end
sourceUrl: internal: Kmila audit F-G-06 (2026-07-12) — SourceElaborator recursive inlining + prefix-chain composition
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Three-level design: `two_stage_top` instantiates `wrapper_mid`, which in turn instantiates `counter_leaf`. Kmila's `SourceElaborator.InlineComponentsToFragments` must recurse to flatten both levels — if it only inlines one level, the elaborated top retains `entity work.counter_leaf` references that the tokenizer then rejects. Regression coverage for audit F-G-06 (session 16, 2026-07-12): recursion already landed in code (comment tag `F-G-06 (2026-07-09)` at line ~608), and session 16 additionally wired the `pathPrefix` argument through the recursive call so sibling multi-level instances compose into `u1__u_scan__foo` / `u2__u_scan__foo` names rather than colliding on the shared `u_scan__foo`. This case has a single mid-instance so it validates recursion; siblings are covered qualitatively by inspection.
